brief.subject: Legacy M1A1 Abrams with researched exterior M2HB CWS and loader M240 miniature reconstruction
brief.intendedUse: Editable finished static source prepared for separately approved rigid-animation production; no historical engineering certification
mustHaveFeatures: Wedge hull with raised rear engine deck
Separate left/right turret cheeks, core, bustle armor, exterior stowage
Seven separate road wheels per side and continuous shoe loops
Army six-tube smoke banks; commander M2 and loader M240 exterior silhouettes
Fixed hatch stations with separate lids, exposed rims, underside seals and shallow dark apertures
Driver lift/swing hatch and three periscopes
192 independently selectable T158 shoes retaining accepted geometry
Antennae, lamps, grilles, blowoff panels, crosswind sensor and muzzle reference fitting
Dark warm seam accents on hatch rims, mantlet and skirt boundaries; selective warm edge highlights on broad upper surfaces
Broad tonal separation of turret roof, cheek shoulders, hatch lids and surrounding hull deck. Original restrained accents retained.
M2 distinct broad jacket, long barrel, rear buffer, M10 exterior cue and cradle/support
M240 tank spade grips, slender barrel and gas-cylinder silhouette, open side cradle and curved lower case container
simplifiableFeatures: Fine fasteners, cables, markings, full interior, terrain suspension and weapon internals excluded
Simplified exterior mounts and shallow wells; hinge dimensions and 4.50m whip tip height are visual construction choices
Edge highlighting and seam contrast are explicitly stylized readability choices, not historical paint markings or physical raised fittings.
Three coherent warm sand values for stylized distance readability, not historical paint markings.

Exterior widths, heights, support cross sections, nominal contact points and simplified rear fittings are visual construction choices constrained by multiple references, not measured engineering specifications.
Closed muzzle caps and shallow dark jacket marks are miniature-scale stylization; no operating internals.
Small pins, chains, straps and hidden feed paths excluded. Existing hatch-ring detail retained.
M2 nominal support bridges original fixed station to forward gun position required by the locked lid sweep; not an exact historical CWS mechanism.
M240 holder follows manual sheet-metal open-top interpretation rather than differing angular photograph equipment.

decisions.outcome: George requested reconstruction after disclosure of source scale and projection discrepancies. Adopt explicit nominal build choices in the complete plan. This record validates implementation of that plan, not historical accuracy or resolution of reference conflicts. Source observations stay immutable. Physical pivot and hidden surfaces are not claimed measured.

Implement George’s finishing request using exact preserved base proportions and explicit equipment/hinge construction choices. The fresh dimension scope includes every final mesh. Incomplete construction checkpoints may report missing future components; none will be presented as validated. No approval transfers.
Implement user-directed seam and edge accents on exact r33 successor; inherited nominal envelope and pivots remain construction targets. Not historical paint claims.
Save r1 fallback; authorize one broad material-value separation successor; exact nominal envelope and pivots preserved.

User-directed weapon reconstruction. Producer dimensions assess retained envelope and pivots; component-plan nominal weapon dimensions and hatch contacts require separate current actual-export checks. All 11 new meshes inside retained envelope. No historical precision or source approval transfer.
